access.general.name: Wi-Fi connectivity problems
access.general.description: Reviewers report the app fails to connect over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some song quality seems poor.

access.login_failure.name: Login and password failures
access.login_failure.description: Users report being unable to log into their accounts or having passwords rejected, alongside complaints about excessive ads.

billing.charges_refund.name: Premium cost concerns
billing.charges_refund.description: Reviewers feel the app has become premium-only to generate revenue for the company.

billing.premium_paywall.name: Features locked behind premium
billing.premium_paywall.description: Users say basic actions like choosing specific songs, skipping, and replaying parts are restricted to premium subscribers.

catalog.general.name: Missing songs and genres
catalog.general.description: Reviewers say the library lacks many songs and certain music genres, such as gospel.

catalog.lyrics.name: Lyrics missing or inconsistent
catalog.lyrics.description: Users report lyrics sometimes fail to appear, and availability differs unpredictably between songs.

catalog.recommendations.name: Weaker song recommendations
catalog.recommendations.description: A reviewer feels recommendations used to offer more songs and more recent releases than they do now.

downloads.download_failure.name: Downloads get stuck
downloads.download_failure.description: A user reports song downloads stalling indefinitely in the background.

downloads.offline_play.name: Offline mode not working
downloads.offline_play.description: A reviewer says the offline feature does not work as expected.

other.general_dislike.name: General negative sentiment
other.general_dislike.description: Reviewers express broad dissatisfaction with the app, often citing recent updates, without specifying a particular problem.

playback.crash_freeze.name: App crashes after update
playback.crash_freeze.description: A user reports the app crashing and becoming unopenable following a recent update.

playback.general.name: General playback bugs
playback.general.description: Users report songs not playing, voice assistant integration failing, and audio adjustment settings not working properly.

playback.lag_loading.name: App stuck loading
playback.lag_loading.description: A reviewer reports the app freezing on the loading or logo screen and never getting past it.

playback.stops_pauses.name: Playback stops unexpectedly
playback.stops_pauses.description: A user reports music repeatedly stopping midway and failing to resume where it left off.

usability.ads.name: Too many or loud ads
usability.ads.description: Reviewers complain about frequent ads interrupting songs, ads that are very loud, and limited ad-free listening for free users.

usability.playlist_library.name: Home screen layout disliked
usability.playlist_library.description: A user dislikes the new home screen design, finding the one-item-at-a-time scrolling layout cumbersome.

usability.shuffle_queue.name: Shuffle and queue frustrations
usability.shuffle_queue.description: Users report playlists playing songs randomly, limited skipping, and being unable to go back or easily play a single chosen song.

usability.ui_layout.name: Blend feature requests
usability.ui_layout.description: A reviewer praises the blend feature and requests the ability to rename blends, noting a recurring issue from years ago.
